extras: Desktop-only for now; mobile support is planned for a later release.
intentEvidence: A git-graph-style view of your PARA vault second brain for Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Beta via BRAT (recommended while in beta)

summary: PARA-Tree provides a git-graph-style visualization of a PARA vault, mapping Areas to trunks, Projects to feature branches, and Resources to commits.
